title: Creative AI Capstone Masters
description: A full Creative AI Capstone apprenticeship: integrate Claude, Perplexity, Figma/Canva, Higgsfield, and CapCut into one end-to-end campaign—from research brief to shipped multi-asset launch.

lessons.title: Capstone Mission and Success Criteria

introduction.text: The capstone is an integrated studio project: pick a real-enough product or course launch and ship a coherent campaign across research, copy, design, motion, and edit. Define success criteria and non-goals up front. Masters work is judged by the system you ran, not a single pretty frame.

questions.question: Capstone success should be defined by:
options: Criteria across research, assets, and coherence
questions.correctAnswer: Criteria across research, assets, and coherence

questions.question: Coherence means:
options: Unified message and look across pieces
questions.correctAnswer: Unified message and look across pieces

project.title: Capstone Charter
project.description: Write a charter: product/offer, audience, success criteria (5), non-goals, channels, and a one-sentence campaign promise. Get a peer (or yourself in critic mode) to stress-test scope.

questions.question: Five criteria help because:
options: You can score the integrated outcome
questions.correctAnswer: You can score the integrated outcome

objectives: Explain the main idea of "Capstone Mission and Success Criteria" without looking at notes
Identify one mistake beginners make on this topic and how to avoid it
Complete a concrete artifact for: Capstone Charter
keyTakeaways: The capstone is an integrated studio project: pick a real-enough product or course launch and ship a coherent campaign across research, copy, design, motion, and edit.
Check understanding with practice before you build.
A small shipped artifact beats a perfect unread summary.

lessons.title: Research Spine with Perplexity + Claude

introduction.text: Start with Perplexity for sourced landscape and Claude for synthesis into a decision brief. Build a claim ledger. Your campaign message must survive contact with evidence. Capstone research is the spine everything else hangs on.

lessons.title: Message System and Copy Pipeline

introduction.text: Turn the brief into a message system: promise, proof points, objections, CTA. Use Claude for draft/critique passes. Lock voice. Every asset should map to the system—no orphan slogans.

options: Lines that do not connect to the system
questions.correctAnswer: Lines that do not connect to the system

questions.question: Critique passes should check:

questions.correctAnswer: Claim safety and clarity vs brief

project.title: Message House
project.description: Build a message house one-pager and three derivative copies: feed caption, story text, and 15s VO script—all mapped to the same promise/proof/CTA with voice notes.

questions.question: Derivative copies should:
options: Adapt length/channel while keeping core truth
questions.correctAnswer: Adapt length/channel while keeping core truth

lessons.title: QA, Packaging, and Launch Retro

introduction.text: Package the campaign: brief, message house, statics, motion, edit master, and claims appendix. Run a cross-asset QA. Launch (or simulated launch) with a retro: what the system learned. Capstone mastery is a repeatable studio loop, not a one-off miracle.

questions.question: Repeatable studio loops mean:
options: You can run the system again with less chaos
questions.correctAnswer: You can run the system again with less chaos
